metrics.definition: Frozen Dataset membership only; never global latest or all Run observations.
metrics.reply_coverage_definition: Selected parent Observation raw response: displayed subCommentCount vs returned subComments; not the platform population or necessarily all Dataset replies.

provenance.note: HEAD is repository context; working implementation hashes identify code, including uncommitted files.

reliability.duration_definition: Seconds in local collection HTTP client call through response reading/parsing; detail includes service-side comment loading. Excludes pacing, media, health/login checks.
reliability.limitations: Wait segments cover only journaled periods; planned retry delay is not actual waiting; invocation reports are not a complete lifecycle event log.
reliability.source: Run-scoped Task/Attempt SQL and available local journals only.
unavailable: Internal platform HTTP duration and scroll count
